title: Combining Aspirin With Ticagrelor or Clopidogrel in Minor Stroke or TIA

sections.abstract: Along with the current clinical trial, the efficacy and safety of a 180 mg loading dose of ticagrelor administered within 24 hours of the first-ever minor stroke or TIA compared to 300 mg clopidogrel were assessed through NIHSS, mRS, and possible adverse effects.
